summary: Backend and platform work on Vend's messaging platform — four Nordic marketplaces (finn.no, blocket.se, tori.fi, dba.dk), one codebase after a near-zero-downtime consolidation, ~30 microservices on Kubernetes, 133M+ requests/day on the largest leg. Occasional frontend forays when a change needs to land end-to-end. Currently building Vend Assistant, an LLM-mediated buyer/seller surface inside the messaging thread — POC through to production shape, adjacent to the team's substrate, not around it.
Open banking under PSD2. Data-sharing APIs for Skatteetaten and Politi. Small team, end-to-end ownership, the kind of code review where the bar is set by the person asking the sharpest question.

Cards platform — global, millions of transactions a day. Led a team to ship a new microservice in two months. Ran a cloud infrastructure pilot on GCP + Pub/Sub, shelved by COVID budget cuts. Agile lead through the org's Atlassian migration.
Identity & access management (STIM), internal React + Spring app, GDPR document-redactor POC on Google Cloud OCR.

Distributed Agile team on the messaging domain that would later consolidate under Vend. 20–30 microservices, 15–20 deploys a day, in-house DevOps + monitoring framework we built because nothing off-the-shelf fit. Test-code volume exceeded production-code volume — deliberate. The messaging expertise I lean on today started here.
Trained cohorts of 30–35 new joiners on core Java and J2EE. Teacher before I was an engineer.
Sprint ceremonies, user stories, code review, deploys to SIT/UAT. Functional analysis and technical documentation.
Peoplesoft ERP enrollments module, end-to-end — requirements gathering through SIT/UAT.
Designed and shipped a rules engine for student admissions and progression at one of South Africa's largest universities.
Java web solutions across mutual funds, fixed deposits, vendor management, and a CMS portal. India's first online mutual-fund trading platform is from this period.
